gk:vocabularyVersion.label: Vocabulary version
gk:vocabularyVersion.description: The version of the Grid Kitchen vocabulary the record uses.

gk:modelClass.label: Model class
gk:modelClass.description: Whether the model is built from a real feeder's data or is a generic model.

gk:useCase.label: Use case
gk:useCase.description: Whether the model represents a feeder in general or was built for given applications.

gk:application.label: Application
gk:application.description: The applications the model was built for. Present only when the use case is ApplicationSpecific.

gk:state.label: State
gk:state.description: USPS code of the state of the feeder head.

gk:regionClass.label: Region class
gk:regionClass.description: Census CBSA type of the county that holds the customer-weighted majority of the service points.

gk:setting.label: Setting
gk:setting.description: NCES locale of the service points, as the customer-weighted majority. Ties go to the earlier value in scheme order.

gk:settingShares.label: Setting shares
gk:settingShares.description: Share of customers in each setting, in scheme order, with zero shares left out.

gk:climateRegion.label: Climate region
gk:climateRegion.description: DOE Building America climate region of the county that holds the customer-weighted majority of the service points.

gk:primaryVoltage.label: Primary voltage
gk:primaryVoltage.description: Line-to-line nominal voltage of the feeder head.

gk:voltageClass.label: Voltage class
gk:voltageClass.description: The smallest of the classes 5, 15, 25 and 35 kV at or above the primary voltage.

gk:hvConnection.label: HV connection
gk:hvConnection.description: Winding connection of the high side of the substation transformer. Left out when that transformer is not modelled.

gk:mvConnection.label: MV connection
gk:mvConnection.description: Winding connection of the low side of the substation transformer, otherwise the connection of the source.

gk:lvConnection.label: LV connection
gk:lvConnection.description: The most common secondary connection of the distribution transformers, by count.

gk:feederLength.label: Feeder length
gk:feederLength.description: Total length of the line segments at the primary voltage.

gk:undergroundShare.label: Underground share
gk:undergroundShare.description: Underground share of the feeder length.

gk:customerCount.label: Customers
gk:customerCount.description: Sum of the customer counts of the loads.

gk:loadSizeDistribution.label: Load size distribution
gk:loadSizeDistribution.description: Share of loads in each size bin, by real power. Left out when there are no loads.

gk:dgSizeDistribution.label: DG size distribution
gk:dgSizeDistribution.description: Share of distributed generators in each size bin, by rated apparent power. Left out when there are no distributed generators.

gk:lowerBound.label: Lower bound
gk:lowerBound.description: Inclusive lower bound of a size bin, in the unit of its distribution.

gk:upperBound.label: Upper bound
gk:upperBound.description: Exclusive upper bound of a size bin, in the unit of its distribution. The last bin has none.

gk:dgCount.label: Distributed generators
gk:dgCount.description: Number of distributed generators (PowerElectronicsConnection and SynchronousMachine), excluding the source.

gk:dgCapacityAC.label: DG capacity (AC)
gk:dgCapacityAC.description: Sum of the rated apparent power of the distributed generators.

gk:evCount.label: Electric vehicles
gk:evCount.description: Number of electric vehicles. Present only when the source has EV data.

gk:recloserCount.label: Reclosers
gk:recloserCount.description: Number of reclosers, including the feeder head device.

gk:substationLTC.label: Substation LTC
gk:substationLTC.description: Whether there is a load tap changer on the substation transformer or at the feeder head.

gk:regulatorCount.label: Regulators
gk:regulatorCount.description: Number of line regulator banks, not single-phase units. The substation LTC is not counted.

gk:capacitorCount.label: Capacitors
gk:capacitorCount.description: Number of capacitor banks, not single-phase units.

gk:secondaryModeling.label: Secondary modeling
gk:secondaryModeling.description: How the secondary system below the distribution transformers is modelled.

gk:lowVoltageNetwork.label: Low-voltage network
gk:lowVoltageNetwork.description: Whether a meshed secondary network is present.

gk:geographicSpecificity.label: Geographic specificity
gk:geographicSpecificity.description: The kind of positions in the shipped data file.

gk:multiFeederCompatible.label: Multi-feeder compatible
gk:multiFeederCompatible.description: Whether the shared substation objects have the same identifiers in every sibling feeder package, so that sibling models can be joined.

gk:contentHash.label: Content hash
gk:contentHash.description: SHA-256 of the shipped payload files, which decides between a MINOR and a PATCH version. Set by the publisher, not part of the feeder record.

gk:component.label: Component
gk:component.description: The model component a quality measurement is about.

gk:provenanceLevel.label: Provenance level
gk:provenanceLevel.description: The stoplight level of a component.

gk:archiveKey.label: Archive key
gk:archiveKey.description: Object key of a shipped archive in the model bucket. Used in catalog distributions.

gk:ModelClass.label: Model class
gk:ModelClass.description: Whether a model is built from a real feeder's data.

gk:UseCase.label: Use case
gk:UseCase.description: What a model was built for.

gk:Application.label: Application
gk:Application.description: An application a model was built for.

gk:RegionClass.label: Region class
gk:RegionClass.description: Census core-based statistical area (CBSA) type of a county.

gk:Setting.label: Setting
gk:Setting.description: Settlement type, from the NCES EDGE locale of a service point.

gk:Connection.label: Connection
gk:Connection.description: Winding connection of a transformer or source.

gk:SecondaryModeling.label: Secondary modeling
gk:SecondaryModeling.description: How the secondary system below the distribution transformers is modelled.

gk:GeographicSpecificity.label: Geographic specificity
gk:GeographicSpecificity.description: The kind of positions in a shipped data file.

gk:ProvenanceLevel.label: Provenance level
gk:ProvenanceLevel.description: The stoplight level of a component.

gk:Component.label: Component
gk:Component.description: A part of a feeder model that gets its own provenance light.

gk:Metric.label: Metric
gk:Metric.description: A DQV metric of the feeder record.

gk:Dimension.label: Dimension
gk:Dimension.description: A DQV quality dimension of the feeder record.

gk:ModelClass.Geographic.label: Geographic
gk:ModelClass.Geographic.description: Built from the data of a real feeder.

gk:ModelClass.Generic.label: Generic
gk:ModelClass.Generic.description: A generic model, not of one real feeder.

gk:UseCase.ApplicationSpecific.label: Application-specific
gk:UseCase.ApplicationSpecific.description: Built for the applications listed in gk:application.

gk:Application.DERManagement.label: DER management
gk:Application.DERManagement.description: Studies of distributed energy resource management.

gk:RegionClass.Metropolitan.label: Metropolitan
gk:RegionClass.Metropolitan.description: The county is in a metropolitan statistical area.

gk:RegionClass.Micropolitan.label: Micropolitan
gk:RegionClass.Micropolitan.description: The county is in a micropolitan statistical area.

gk:RegionClass.Outside.label: Outside a CBSA
gk:RegionClass.Outside.description: The county is in no core-based statistical area.

gk:Setting.Rural.label: Rural
gk:Setting.Rural.description: NCES locale Town (31, 32, 33) or Rural Fringe (41).

gk:Setting.DeepRural.label: Deep rural
gk:Setting.DeepRural.description: NCES locale Rural Distant or Rural Remote (42, 43).

gk:ClimateRegion.VeryCold.label: Very cold
gk:ClimateRegion.VeryCold.description: Building America very cold climate region.

gk:Connection.OpenDelta.label: Open delta
gk:Connection.OpenDelta.description: Open delta connection (a bank of two units).

gk:Connection.OpenWye.label: Open wye
gk:Connection.OpenWye.description: Open wye connection (a bank of two units).

gk:Connection.Zigzag.label: Zigzag
gk:Connection.Zigzag.description: Zigzag (interconnected star) connection, grounded or not.

gk:Connection.SinglePhase.label: Single-phase
gk:Connection.SinglePhase.description: A single-phase winding that is not a center-tapped secondary.

gk:SecondaryModeling.None.label: None
gk:SecondaryModeling.None.description: The loads are on the primary; no distribution transformers or secondaries.

gk:GeographicSpecificity.LatLong.label: Latitude and longitude
gk:GeographicSpecificity.LatLong.description: Positions in a WGS84 coordinate system (EPSG:4326).

gk:GeographicSpecificity.XY.label: XY layout
gk:GeographicSpecificity.XY.description: Positions in any other coordinate system, including a generated layout.

gk:GeographicSpecificity.None.label: None
gk:GeographicSpecificity.None.description: The data file has no positions.

gk:ProvenanceLevel.Sourced.label: From source data
gk:ProvenanceLevel.Sourced.description: At least 80% of the component's objects have all key parameters from the source data.

gk:ProvenanceLevel.Inferred.label: Inferred
gk:ProvenanceLevel.Inferred.description: Less than 80% of the component's objects have all key parameters from the source data, or the values were perturbed for privacy.

gk:ProvenanceLevel.Missing.label: Missing
gk:ProvenanceLevel.Missing.description: The component exists in the real feeder, but the source has no data for it.

gk:ProvenanceLevel.NotPresent.label: None on this feeder
gk:ProvenanceLevel.NotPresent.description: The source confirms that the feeder has none of the component.

gk:Component.Topology.label: Topology
gk:Component.Topology.description: Counted by line segment and switch. Key parameters: connectivity, phasing.

gk:Component.Conductors.label: Conductors
gk:Component.Conductors.description: Counted by line segment. Key parameters: conductor type, impedance or spacing.

gk:Component.DistributionTransformers.label: Distribution transformers
gk:Component.DistributionTransformers.description: Counted by transformer. Key parameters: kVA, connection or secondary voltage, impedance.

gk:Component.SubstationSource.label: Substation source
gk:Component.SubstationSource.description: Counted by source and substation transformer. Key parameters: source impedance, transformer rating, LTC settings.

gk:Component.Loads.label: Loads
gk:Component.Loads.description: Counted by load. Key parameters: location, kW and kVAr.

gk:Component.DER.label: DER
gk:Component.DER.description: Counted by distributed generator. Key parameters: location, rating, type.

gk:Component.Protection.label: Protection
gk:Component.Protection.description: Counted by fuse, recloser and sectionalizer. Key parameters: location, type, rating.

gk:Component.VoltageControl.label: Voltage control
gk:Component.VoltageControl.description: Counted by regulator bank and capacitor bank. Key parameters: location, rating, control settings.

gk:Component.Secondary.label: Secondary
gk:Component.Secondary.description: Counted by service or secondary conductor. Key parameters: presence, conductor.

gk:Component.Coordinates.label: Coordinates
gk:Component.Coordinates.description: Counted by connectivity node. Key parameter: coordinate.

gk:Component.TimeSeries.label: Time series
gk:Component.TimeSeries.description: Counted by load and DG profile. Key parameter: profile.

gk:Metric.SourcedShare.label: Sourced share
gk:Metric.SourcedShare.description: Share of a component's objects whose key parameters all come from the source data, from 0 to 1.

gk:Dimension.Provenance.label: Provenance
gk:Dimension.Provenance.description: Whether the values of a model come from the source data or were inferred.
